desc:
Welcome to Throw Food To Fight Animals!

How to Play:
🥕 Throw food into different areas to lure animals
✨ Teleport to the area when your food lands
🐎 Ride your animal into battle
⚔️ Defeat the animal you lured within 30 seconds
🦁 Win the fight to add that animal to your collection
🌍 Explore new areas and battle stronger animals!
